how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_010.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.ghoul.descript: A vampiric thrall brought about by Blood Raise, highly weakened by sunlight.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.giant.descript: A race of powerful Majin most notable for their incredible physical capabilities and Magic Resistance.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.goblin.descrip: A race of Sprite Demi-Humans. They seem to be descended from the offspring of Dwarves and Oni.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.god_slime.desc: The divine stage of evolution of Slimes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.greater_daemon: The daemon race that lesser daemons evolve to when they develop their ego and accumulate enough power.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.harpy.descript: A race of winged Majin with capability to cancel out flight spell and are often referred to as the rulers of the skies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.harpy_queen.de: A Queen Species of Harpy with the ability to reproduce through Parthenogenesis or Virgin Birth.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.high_orc.descr: The evolved form of Orcs. They are smarter than Orcs while preserving the Orc race's special characteristics, with appearance virtually identical to regular Orcs.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.hobgoblin.desc: The evolved form of male Goblins that is ranked D on average.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.hobgoblin_sain: Hobgoblin that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.human.descript: A weak but populous race that relies more on technology and numbers than brute force. Their low magicule count makes skills and magic users a rarity among them, instead favouring battlewill.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.human_saint.de: Human that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.kijin.descript: A race of Sprite Demi-Humans descended from Fire Elementals. They have an average lifespan of over a thousand years
The lowest level of the daemon race. They spontaneously come into existence within the Daemon Realm where they slowly accumulate experience from fighting and being summoned before eventually evolving into greater daemons.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.lizardman.desc: A race of scaled people descended from dragons. Their webbed feet give them an advantage in wet terrain.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.merfolk.descri: A sprite race descended from water elementals. Their fish-like bodies give them an insurmountable advantage in water.
Merfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.metal_slime.de: A slime that has taken in large quantities of Magic Ore. The dissolved ore inside of it provides a strong resistance towards most forms of damage.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.mystic_oni.des: The result of Kijin fully returning to their roots as Elementals, making them Spiritual Lifeforms.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.ogre.descripti: A sprite race descended from fire elementals. They possess immense physical capabilities and a strong Japanese lineage.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.orc.descriptio: A race of beastfolk who lost the ability to shift between man and beast, resulting in a permanent mix of the two. Their physical strength is greater than average but pails in comparison to their original strength as beastfolk.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.orc_disaster.d: The evolution of an Orc Lord that is a Demon Lord Seed.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.orc_lord.descr: A very rare and powerful member of the Orc race with high intelligence who appears roughly every few centuries.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.slime.descript: A Spectral race of monster that lacks intelligence and ambition. They’re usually passive but are incredibly ruthless once provoked.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_beast.d: Beastfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_bird.de: Harpy that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_boar.de: Orc that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_oni.des: Oni that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_skeleto: Wight that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.true_dragonewt: The evolution of Dragonewts and complete Spiritual Lifeforms. They are the second-highest evolutionary stage of Dragonewt known to exist.
